title: 01  Open Discover
detail: Real local app + isolated API. Vietnamese cards show verified events and recent place mentions.

title: 02  Choose a city
detail: Open the location picker and select Hanoi. The feed changes with the city.

title: 03  Filter events
detail: Tap Sự kiện. Read the event title, venue, date in Vietnam time, address and evidence label.

title: 04  Browse the carousel
detail: Scroll sideways to the next event. Ticket prices appear when verified in the source.

title: 05  Open the original source
detail: Tap Nguồn on the card. The publisher opens in a new browser tab.

title: 06  Read publisher information
detail: Original event page: dates, location and full information. This is the actual external website.

title: 07  Return and inspect image credits
detail: Back in Lô, the photo is labelled Ảnh minh họa. Its credit is separate from event-source evidence.

title: 08  Follow the photo credit
detail: The correct Unsplash asset link opens, but the external site denies access in this browser. The bundled illustration still works in Lô.

title: 09  Show recently mentioned places
detail: Return to the app and tap Địa điểm. Fresh place mentions have their own evidence label.

title: 10  Open the matched venue
detail: Tap Khám phá địa điểm. A confidently matched card opens the existing venue screen.

title: 11  Inspect available venue details
detail: Read the stored address and venue information. Missing hours or other details are shown honestly.

title: 12  Return to Discover
detail: Tap Discover in the bottom navigation to return to the trending feed.

title: 13  Switch to Ho Chi Minh City
detail: Choose Ho Chi Minh City and Tất cả to browse its verified local events.

title: 14  Check an honest empty state
detail: Tap Địa điểm. With no eligible recent place mentions, the app shows an empty state instead of fabricated cards.

title: 15  Refresh the feed
detail: Tap Làm mới. The app fetches the stored feed again; it does not start scraping while you browse.

title: 16  Explore Da Nang
detail: Select Da Nang and Tất cả. Read verified cultural events and the Dragon Bridge schedule.

title: 17  What this demo verifies
detail: Real website-derived feed, filters, links and venue navigation. Social publication stays disabled; no production rollout or live Google search is claimed.
